title: Kani Tamago Maki
description: A mild, colorful nori roll with crab stick, omelet and cucumber.

ingredients.name: Prepared, seasoned sushi rice
ingredients.note: Use the separate Sushi Rice recipe

steps: Beat eggs with mirin and cook until set. Cool, then cut into long strips.
Drain ready-to-eat crab sticks and cut into manageable strips. Cut cucumber into thin batons.
Spread rice onto nori, layer crab, tamago, cucumber and a light drizzle of Kewpie lengthwise.
Roll firmly and divide into eight pieces.
notes: Fully cool the egg before rolling to avoid steam softening nori.
This baseline yields approximately four rolls (or the equivalent nigiri, gunkan or hand-roll assortment), about six light servings.
Sushi rice is prepared and seasoned separately; the rice quantity here is its ready-to-use weight.
